names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 21 martie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 21 Μαρτίου, «Όσιος Σεραφείμ», with the rank word left off.

birth.note: doxologia.ro's life for the day: «Vasile Muraviev (viitorul Sfânt Serafim) s-a născut în anul 1865, în orașul Cheremovsky din provincia Yaroslavl».

death.note: doxologia.ro's life for the day: «Sfântul Serafim a plecat la Domnul la 21 martie 1949».

attestations.note: The Romanian life says the Church of Russia canonised him in August 2000, but no Russian calendar was read for him: days.pravoslavie.ru was not checked (19 September 2026).

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 21 martie — «Sfântul Serafim de Virița»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 21ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Σεραφείμ»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The page heads him «(1865 - 1949)» and agrees with the corpus's years, so nothing in the dates field has been changed; it places his birth more exactly, in the village of Vakhromeevo of the Arefinskaya district in the region of Yaroslavl, where doxologia had the town of Cheremovsky in the province of Yaroslavl. Its account is much the longest of the day's and is only summarised in the paragraph added to the life.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
